context.title: League of Women Voters of San Francisco — June 2, 2026 ballot recommendations

of.name: League of Women Voters of San Francisco

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition A (Earthquake Safety and Emergency Response Bond)

positions.statement: 'Responsible, necessary' infrastructure investment with public oversight.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Lifetime Term Limits for Mayor and Board of Supervisors)

positions.statement: Opposes restricting voter choice; argues term limits reduce accountability.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Decreases in Business Taxes)

positions.statement: Opposes given city's budget deficit and need for revenue to protect services.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Increases to Business Tax Based on Executive Pay Comparison)

positions.statement: Restores a 2020 voter-approved measure, expected to raise $250M-$350M annually.
